summary_en: Kusurinomadoguchi acquires 100% of blankpad via board resolution on 2026-07-23 to make it a wholly-owned subsidiary. Blankpad operates a personality-diagnosis and AI-powered talent-matching platform. Acquisition purpose: combine blankpad's analysis capabilities with Kusurinomadoguchi's existing pharmacist recruitment subsidiary to improve matching precision and retention in pharmacy staffing.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of shares of blankpad Inc. (making it a wholly-owned subsidiary)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-23, Kusurinomadoguchi Inc. announced via board resolution the acquisition of 100% of blankpad Inc. to make it a wholly-owned subsidiary. blankpad, established in August 2023, operates a personality-diagnosis and AI-powered total talent-matching platform business. Current ownership: NBSE Inc. (96.77%), Shinozaki Takenobu (3.06%), Horikawa Taiga (0.16%). Kusurinomadoguchi holds a subsidiary called Yakuzaishi Kyujin Tensyoku Inc. focused on pharmacist-specialist recruitment for community pharmacies. The acquisition aims to combine blankpad's analytical capabilities—which map personality traits of job seekers and organizational culture of employers—with the existing recruitment subsidiary to improve matching precision and post-hire retention in pharmacy staffing. blankpad has been loss-making and is early-stage (established 2023); however, Kusurinomadoguchi views its proprietary matching technology as valuable and strategically important for competitive advantage in the healthcare recruitment sector. The filing notes existing large-chain pharmacy clients already have implementation experience with blankpad's tools and anticipates rapid deployment of the combined service post-acquisition. No acquisition price, share count, or consideration amount is disclosed in the extracted text.
